mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recruitment_request ( request_title, total_recruitment_count, vacancy_count, interviewer, position_or_team, team_manager, category, technical_platform, type, supplement_count, urgent_requirement, proposed_level, experience_years, position_responsibility, status, position_publish_status, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{requestTitle}, #{totalRecruitmentCount}, #{vacancyCount}, #{interviewer}, #{positionOrTeam}, #{teamManager}, #{category}, #{technicalPlatform}, #{type}, #{supplementCount}, #{urgentRequirement}, #{proposedLevel}, #{experienceYears}, #{positionResponsibility}, #{status}, #{positionPublishStatus}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE recruitment_request SET request_title = #{requestTitle}, total_recruitment_count = #{totalRecruitmentCount}, vacancy_count = #{vacancyCount}, interviewer = #{interviewer}, position_or_team = #{positionOrTeam}, team_manager = #{teamManager}, category = #{category}, technical_platform = #{technicalPlatform}, type = #{type}, supplement_count = #{supplementCount}, urgent_requirement = #{urgentRequirement}, proposed_level = #{proposedLevel}, experience_years = #{experienceYears}, position_responsibility = #{positionResponsibility}, status = #{status}, position_publish_status = #{positionPublishStatus}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE recruitment_request_id = #{recruitmentRequestId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recruitment_request ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recruitment_request SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approval_user_id = #{approvalUserId}, approval_user_name = #{approvalUserName}, approval_time = NOW(), approval_comment = #{approvalComment} WHERE recruitment_request_id = #{recruitmentRequestId}
